# related note

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:relatedNote`](gmeow-relatedNote.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/relatedNote>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

An undirected associative link between two notes — the semantic sibling of [`relatedTag`](gmeow-relatedTag.md), applied to the note graph. Symmetric. Optional: the note graph stays flat-first.
